stories.title: “Some relief this morning”: police log a clear night after run of Flintshire fires
stories.summary: North Wales Police officers in north Flintshire reported no arson incidents overnight, after a run of fires in the open across the county. North Wales Police North Flintshire said in a daily policing update: “Some relief this morning to see we’ve had no arson reports overnight”. Fires in the open have been a repeated problem

stories.title: Darts venue approved for Connah’s Quay industrial unit despite neighbour’s safety warning
stories.summary: Plans to turn part of a Connah’s Quay industrial unit into an indoor darts venue have been approved, despite a neighbouring business warning of a safety risk in the shared yard. stories.title: Airbus order backlog passes 9,200 aircraft as deliveries rise at half year
stories.summary: Airbus has 9,222 commercial aircraft still on its order book, the company said on Wednesday, after delivering 351 in the first half of 2026 with wings built at Broughton. stories.title: Chester Zoo launches 5,000 mile challenge to raise £10,000 for tiger conservation
stories.summary: Chester Zoo has launched a month long fundraising challenge for tiger conservation, asking supporters to cover 5,000 miles between them and raise £10,000. stories.title: Boy’s life saved on Saltney street after bike fall, Cheshire Police say
stories.summary: A boy who suffered a suspected arterial bleed after falling from his bike in Saltney was kept alive by four passers-by and four police officers, Cheshire Constabulary has said.
